info.description: Contests, squares, participants, invites, leaderboard, and stats for squares.maxhq.io. Served under /squares behind the gateway, which validates the bearer token.
info.title: Squares Contests API

get.description: Contests the caller owns or has joined, newest first, one page at a time. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

parameters.description: Replays the first response when a create is retried with the same key
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

409.description: You already have a contest with this name

get.description: Owner gets all invite links for a contest
get.summary: Get all invites for a contest

post.description: Owner creates an invite link with specified role and square limit
post.summary: Create an invite link for a contest

get.description: Returns all participants and their roles. Any participant can view. Public contests allow any authenticated user
get.summary: Get all participants for a contest

delete.description: Owner removes a participant, or a participant removes themselves; the removed participant's squares are cleared. The owner cannot be removed.
delete.summary: Remove a participant from a contest

patch.description: Owner updates a participant's role or max squares
patch.summary: Update a participant's role or square limit

delete.description: Clears the value and owner of every square owned by the authenticated user. Only the caller's own squares are affected.

409.description: The board is full and locked

post.description: Claims up to count random empty squares for the caller in one step, capped by their square limit and what is left

put.description: Claims a square for the authenticated user using their profile default initials
put.summary: Claim a single square in a contest
